devdoc.details: This implementation was specifically designed to work with UniswapV2

OptimalUtilRate().details: Error thrown when optimal util rate set to 0 or greater or equal to 1e18

WrongTokenBalance(address).details: Error thrown when wrong amount of ERC20 token is deposited in GammaPool

params.token: - address of ERC20 token that caused the error

Deposit(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: Event emitted when a deposit of CFMM LP tokens in exchange of GS LP tokens happens (e.g. _deposit, _mint, _depositReserves, _depositNoPull)

params.caller: - address calling the function to deposit CFMM LP tokens

PoolUpdated(uint256,uint256,uint40,uint8.details: Event emitted when the Pool's global state variables is updated

params.accFeeIndex: - interest of total accrued interest in the GammaPool until current update
params.cfmmReserves: - reserves in CFMM. Used to track price
params.lastBlockNumber: - last block the Pool's where updated
params.lpTokenBalance: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens deposited in the pool
params.lpTokenBorrowed: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens that have been borrowed from the pool (principal)
params.lpTokenBorrowedPlusInterest: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens that have been borrowed from the pool including interest
params.txType: - transaction type. Possible values come from enum TX_TYPE

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when transferring GS LP token from one address (`from`) to another (`to`)

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens transferred

Withdraw(address,address,address,uint256.details: Event emitted when a withdrawal of CFMM LP tokens happens (e.g. _withdraw, _redeem, _withdrawReserves, _withdrawNoPull)

params.assets: - amount of CFMM LP tokens withdrawn
params.caller: - address calling the function to withdraw CFMM LP tokens
params.shares: - amount of GS LP tokens redeemed

_depositNoPull(address).details: Deposit CFMM LP tokens and get GS LP tokens, without doing a transferFrom transaction. Must have sent CFMM LP tokens first

params.to: - address of receiver of GS LP token

returns.shares: - quantity of GS LP tokens received for CFMM LP tokens

_depositReserves(address,uint256[],uint2.details: Deposit reserve token quantities to CFMM (instead of CFMM LP tokens) to get CFMM LP tokens, store them in GammaPool and receive GS LP tokens

params.amountsDesired: - desired amounts of reserve tokens to deposit
params.amountsMin: - minimum amounts of reserve tokens to deposit
params.to: - address of receiver of GS LP tokens

returns.reserves: - quantity of actual reserve tokens deposited in CFMM
returns.shares: - quantity of GS LP tokens received for reserve tokens deposited

_withdrawNoPull(address).details: Withdraw CFMM LP tokens, by burning GS LP tokens, without doing a transferFrom transaction. Must have sent GS LP tokens first

params.to: - address of receiver of CFMM LP tokens

returns.assets: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens received for GS LP tokens

_withdrawReserves(address).details: Withdraw reserve token quantities of CFMM (instead of CFMM LP tokens), by burning GS LP tokens

params.to: - address of receiver of reserve token quantities

returns.assets: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens representing reserve tokens withdrawn
returns.reserves: - quantity of reserve tokens withdrawn from CFMM and sent to receiver

calcUtilRateEma(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Update pool invariant, LP tokens borrowed plus interest, interest rate index, and last block update

params.emaMultiplier: - interest accrued to loans in GammaPool
params.emaUtilRateLast: - interest accrued to loans in GammaPool
params.utilizationRate: - interest accrued to loans in GammaPool

returns.emaUtilRate: - interest accrued to loans in GammaPool

constructor.details: Initializes the contract by setting `MAX_TOTAL_APY`, `BLOCKS_PER_YEAR`, `baseRate`, `optimalUtilRate`, `slope1`, and `slope2`

getLastFees(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint.details: Calculate fees charged by GammaPool since last update to liquidity loans and current borrow rate

params.borrowedInvariant: - invariant amount borrowed in GammaPool including accrued interest calculated in last update to GammaPool
params.lastCFMMFeeIndex: - last fees accrued by CFMM since last update
params.lastCFMMInvariant: - current invariant amount of CFMM in GammaPool
params.lastCFMMTotalSupply: - current total supply of CFMM LP shares in GammaPool
params.prevCFMMInvariant: - invariant amount in CFMM in last update to GammaPool
params.prevCFMMTotalSupply: - total supply in CFMM in last update to GammaPool

returns.lastFeeIndex: - last fees charged by GammaPool since last update
returns.updatedLastCFMMFeeIndex: - updated fees accrued by CFMM till current block

getLatestBalances(uint256,uint256,uint25.details: Calculate balances updated by fees charged since last update

params.borrowedInvariant: - invariant amount borrowed in GammaPool including accrued interest calculated in last update to GammaPool
params.lastFeeIndex: - last fees charged by GammaPool since last update
params.lpBalance: - amount of LP tokens deposited in GammaPool

returns.lastBorrowedLPBalance: - last fees charged by GammaPool since last update
returns.lastLPBalance: - last fees accrued by CFMM since last update

params.pool: - address of contract to get parameters for

returns._1: optimalUtilRate - target utilization rate of model

totalAssets(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint.details: Calculate current total CFMM LP tokens (real and virtual) in existence in the GammaPool, including accrued interest

params.borrowedInvariant: - invariant amount borrowed in GammaPool including accrued interest calculated in last update to GammaPool
params.lastFeeIndex: - last fees charged by GammaPool since last update
params.lpBalance: - amount of LP tokens deposited in GammaPool

returns.lastLPBalance: totalAssets - total CFMM LP tokens in existence in the pool (real and virtual) including accrued interest

totalSupply(address,address,uint256,uint.details: Calculate current total GS LP tokens in the GammaPool after dilution from protocol fees

params.factory: - address of factory contract that created GammaPool
params.lastFeeIndex: - last fees charged by GammaPool since last update
params.pool: - address of pool to get interest rate calculations for
params.supply: - actual GS LP total supply available in the pool

returns._0: totalSupply - total GS LP tokens in the pool including accrued interest

calcBorrowRate(uint256,uint256,address,a.notice: formula is as follows: max{ baseRate + (utilRate * slope1) / optimalRate, baseRate + slope1 + slope2 * (utilRate - optimalRate) / (1 - optimalUtilRate) }
